europe_now.title: Diplomatic Push in Ukraine Conflict
europe_now.summary: United States envoys have arrived in Moscow and Kyiv to advance diplomatic efforts regarding the war. Meanwhile, leadership has signaled temporary operational pauses.

top_stories.title: Diplomatic Initiatives and Ceasefire Developments
top_stories.summary: American envoys traveled to Moscow and Kyiv to pursue discussions aimed at addressing the ongoing conflict. Leadership in the region subsequently approved a 72-hour ceasefire.
